items.body: The programme's acceptance standard changes. A project is done only when (a) every gate clause is discharged by executable checks with an explicit kind (record/probe/code); (b) every mandatory artefact is evidenced with a published document; (c) every P0/P1 package is resolved; (d) every gate records a rule decision with a resolving delegation_ref; (e) outputs are published at the head; (f) the SAFe rows exist; (g) a Phase-G review with snapshot_sha triages findings; (h) the risk, ADR and benefit registers are operated; (i) no finding and no waiver is open; (j) the published pack is current at the head. No deferral is a disposition. Impact analysis and the affected verdicts are in meta.impact and the #526 work table (comment 7077202144). This change row stays open until its `change` gate can be approved: the guard reads meta.change_id, which no action writes today (v1-change-1, fix in flight). Approving it before that fix would be a false record, so it is not approved here.

meta.blocked_by: v1-change-1: the change gate's approval reads meta.change_id, which approvals.request does not write

impact.risk: Red-first landing: 98 open findings and 539 packages become visible; no green is claimed until they clear.
impact.schedule: Applies retroactively to tranche 3 and every later tranche review.
impact.scope: All 47 project manifests and four instruments change verdict semantics; the 12 green projects are re-rendered under the executed-gate rule and the count is expected to fall.

items.title: Change: the enhanced acceptance standard (gates executed, no deferrals)
